intro: This errand introduces adventurers to Dungar Longdrink, the chief gryphon master of Stormwind. After collecting emergency supplies from Osric Strang, couriers must arrange for swift aerial transport to deliver the gear back to the embattled defenders in Westfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for. Can you take it to him?
If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him. Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.
Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can. We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is that sweat on your brow, friend? You've been running too much. Next time, take a gryphon!

clips.title: Completion
paras: A crate for Westfall, eh? Have you been to Westfall before? If so, then it's no problem, my friend. I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
